Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 5. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 6. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 7. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 8. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 9. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 3 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 10. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. General Technical Requirements 1.1. All equipment offered shall be brand new, unused, genuine, of current production and sourced throug h authorized channels. 1.2. The offered products shall be of professional/high-end quality, suitable for demanding operational envi ronments and continuous field use. 1.3. The bidder shall submit complete technical specifications, manufacturer details, model numbers, prod uct catalogues and relevant technical literature along with the bid. 1.4. The bidder shall clearly identify the manufacturer and country of origin of each offered item. 1.5. Refurbished, reconditioned, obsolete or discontinued products shall not be accepted. 2. Walkie-Talkie – Professional Communication Equipment

2.1. The offered walkie-talkie shall be a professional-grade communication device suitable for reliable two- way communication. 2.2. The equipment shall have robust construction and be suitable for outdoor and demanding environmen tal conditions. 2.3. The bidder shall specify the communication range under realistic operating conditions. Advertised ma ximum range alone shall not be considered sufficient evidence of performance. 2.4. The equipment shall have adequate battery backup for extended operational use, with rechargeable b attery and charging accessories. 2.5. The bidder shall provide details of audio clarity, speaker output, microphone quality and noise-handlin g capability. 2.6. The equipment shall have appropriate ingress protection against dust and water, supported by valid t est documentation. 2.7. All offered radio equipment shall comply with applicable Indian wireless communication regulations, in cluding WPC/DoT licensing and frequency authorization requirements, wherever applicable. 2.8. The bidder shall clearly specify the supported frequency bands, applicable approvals and regulatory c ompliance documents. 2.9. All standard accessories, including antenna, battery, charger, belt clip and user manual, shall be inclu ded in the quoted price. 2.10. The bidder shall ensure compatibility among the supplied units and accessories wherever required u nder the tender specifications. 3. Helmet-Mounted Light – High-End Operational Grade 3.1. The helmet-mounted light shall be of professional/high-end quality and suitable for hands-free illumina tion in low-light environments. 3.2. The light shall have a rugged and compact design, suitable for helmet mounting and field applications. 3.3. The offered product shall provide adequate illumination with clearly specified brightness, beam chara cteristics and operating modes. 3.4. The bidder shall specify the available white-light and any additional illumination modes offered in the proposed model. 3.5. The equipment shall have a secure helmet-mounting arrangement and shall not become loose during normal movement or vibration. 3.6. The light shall have a rechargeable or replaceable battery system, with clearly specified battery capac ity and operating duration. 3.7. The product shall have suitable protection against dust, moisture and environmental exposure, suppor ted by manufacturer documentation or test certificates. 3.8. The bidder shall provide details of weight, dimensions, mounting compatibility and material of constru ction. 3.9. The offered equipment shall be supplied with all necessary mounting accessories, batteries, chargers (where applicable) and operating instructions. 3.10. The product shall be tested for reliable operation under the manufacturer's specified operating temp erature and environmental conditions. 4. Infrared (IR) Helipad Light – High-End Aviation Grade 4.1. The offered IR helipad lighting equipment shall be purpose-designed for aviation/helipad lighting appli cations and shall be suitable for the intended installation environment. 4.2. The equipment shall be of high-quality industrial/aviation-grade construction, designed for reliable ope ration in outdoor environments.

4.3. The bidder shall submit complete technical details of infrared wavelength, optical output, beam chara cteristics, visibility/performance parameters and operating specifications. 4.4. The offered equipment shall be compatible with the intended aviation night-landing visual aid system and the specified installation arrangement. 4.5. The bidder shall submit manufacturer test reports and relevant product certifications demonstrating c onformity with applicable aviation lighting standards. 4.6. The equipment shall have appropriate protection against water ingress, dust, vibration, temperature v ariation and other environmental conditions relevant to helipad installations. 4.7. The bidder shall specify the power supply requirements, electrical consumption, operating voltage and backup arrangements, wherever applicable. 4.8. The product shall be designed for reliable continuous or duty-cycle operation as required by the inten ded application. 4.9. The bidder shall provide details of installation requirements, mounting arrangements, maintenance pr ocedures and expected service life. 4.10. The offered IR lighting system shall be compatible with the intended night-vision equipment and shal l meet the technical requirements specified by the Buyer. 4.11. Any necessary controller, power supply, mounting hardware, connectors and installation accessories shall be clearly identified in the technical bid. 5. Technical Documentation and Compliance 5.1. The bidder shall submit the following documents wherever applicable: Manufacturer's product catalogue and technical datasheet. Manufacturer Authorization Certificate (MAF), if required by the tender. Country of Origin declaration. Product conformity and quality certificates. Environmental and ingress protection test reports. Warranty certificate. Regulatory approvals and applicable statutory clearances. Declaration of authenticity and newness of equipment. 5.2. Generic brochures without model-specific technical information shall not be treated as sufficient proof of compliance. 5.3. The Buyer reserves the right to seek additional technical clarification or documentary evidence from t he bidder. 6. Technical Evaluation and Demonstration 6.1. The Buyer reserves the right to conduct technical evaluation of the offered equipment before final acc eptance. 6.2. The bidder may be required to arrange a physical demonstration or sample inspection of the offered p roducts, wherever specified by the Buyer. 6.3. The demonstration shall establish conformity with the essential technical requirements, functionality a nd manufacturer-declared performance. 6.4. Any product found technically non-compliant with the essential specifications may be rejected. 6.5. The decision on technical responsiveness shall be based on the published tender requirements and ap plicable procurement rules. 7. Inspection and Acceptance 7.1. All supplied equipment shall be subject to inspection by the authorized representative of the Buyer. 7.2. The Buyer reserves the right to verify model numbers, serial numbers, accessories, physical condition

and technical specifications. 7.3. Any defective, damaged, counterfeit or specification-mismatched equipment shall be liable for rejection. 7.4. Replacement of rejected equipment shall be carried out by the supplier at no additional cost to the Bu yer within the stipulated replacement period. 7.5. Final acceptance shall be issued only after satisfactory inspection and verification. 8. Delivery and Packaging 8.1. The supplier shall deliver all items within the delivery schedule specified in the Purchase Order. 8.2. All equipment shall be properly packed to prevent damage during transportation, handling and storag e. 8.3. The packaging shall clearly indicate the product description, model number, quantity and handling ins tructions. 8.4. The supplier shall be responsible for damage attributable to improper packaging or transportation bef ore delivery and acceptance. 9. Warranty and After-Sales Support 9.1. The minimum warranty shall be as specified in the tender schedule or Purchase Order. 9.2. The warranty shall cover manufacturing defects, material defects and workmanship-related failures u nder normal intended use. 9.3. The supplier shall provide repair or replacement support during the warranty period without additional cost where the defect is covered by warranty. 9.4. The bidder shall provide details of the authorized service centre, service contact and complaint escala tion mechanism. 9.5. The supplier shall ensure availability of essential spare parts and accessories for a reasonable period a fter supply. 9.6. Warranty obligations shall be supported by a written warranty certificate from the manufacturer or au thorized supplier. 10. Training and User Documentation 10.1. The supplier shall provide operating manuals and technical documentation for all supplied equipmen t. 10.2. Basic user training and product familiarization shall be provided wherever required by the Buyer and specified in the Purchase Order. 10.3. All manuals shall preferably be provided in English. 11. Price and Commercial Conditions 11.1. The quoted price shall be inclusive of all accessories, standard attachments, packaging and other co mponents required for complete supply, as specified in the tender. 11.2. The bidder shall separately indicate applicable taxes, transportation, insurance, installation and othe r charges wherever required. 11.3. The quoted prices shall remain firm during the stipulated bid validity and contract execution period, subject to the original tender conditions. 11.4. No additional charges shall be payable for items or accessories expressly included in the quoted sco pe of supply. 12. Delivery Delay and Liquidated Damages

12.1. Delay in delivery attributable to the supplier shall attract liquidated damages in accordance with the provisions of the original tender and Purchase Order. 12.2. The supplier shall immediately notify the Buyer in writing regarding any anticipated delay, along with supporting reasons. 12.3. Any extension of delivery period shall require prior written approval from the competent authority. 13. Integrity and Authenticity 13.1. The bidder shall ensure that all products supplied are genuine and sourced from the original manufac turer or an authorized distribution channel. 13.2. Any false declaration, misrepresentation or submission of forged certificates may result in rejection o f the bid or other action permissible under applicable procurement rules. 13.3. The bidder shall disclose any material conflict of interest relevant to the procurement. 14. Right of the Buyer 14.1. The Buyer reserves the right to verify the credentials, technical capability and authorization status of the bidder. 14.2. The Buyer may seek clarifications and supporting documents in accordance with applicable procure ment rules. 14.3. The Buyer reserves the right to reject technically non-responsive bids in accordance with the tender provisions. 14.4. Any change in the offered make, model or technical configuration after bid submission shall require p rior written approval wherever permissible under the tender. 15. General and Legal Conditions 15.1. All provisions of the original tender document shall remain applicable unless specifically supplement ed by these ATC. 15.2. In case of inconsistency, the order of precedence specified in the original tender shall apply. 15.3. All disputes shall be dealt with in accordance with the applicable laws and dispute resolution provisio ns of the contract. 15.4. These Additional Terms & Conditions shall be read in conjunction with the technical specifications, co mmercial conditions and Purchase Order. .
